snippet.title: scarra
snippet.description:
This is William "Scarra" Li's official youtube channel, you can expect regular League of Legends content from Highlights of my Twitch streams to League Patch note reviews. 
Be sure to subscribe to be notified when I upload a new video!

Follow me on Twitter:
www.twitter.com/scarra

Follow me on Twitch:
www.twitch.tv/scarra

Follow the editors of this channel:
https://twitter.com/vultaredits
https://twitter.com/leafyfille

Feedback-Sheet: http://goo.gl/forms/Va7hBhrJMc
